reviews.x: This review is for: Cure Series Japanese Exfoliating Bath Towel from OHE - Hard Weave - Green, 110cm  I have been using bamboo brushes to scrub my back for years. Unfortunately they tend to mildew and fall apart rather quickly. They are also very impractical for travel. I saw this and decided to give it a try. No more brushes for this guy.  This thing is like one of those bath scrunchie things that hasn't been scrunched up into a ball. the description says "110cm". That's 43 1/4 inches.

This is the third brand bath cloth I have bought and it's exactly what I had been looking for: it's rough (but not too rough), and not heavy while using. The green and pink 110cm Cure towels are the leyije length.  I also tried out the blue one which is a little longer, but this is personal preference.  I prefer the blue for normal use and the green / pink length for traveling, personally.  about the other two brands: - leyijie towels: it's like using sandpaper - aquis: good feel, but the materi

Hard weave is not *that* hard if you're used to washing with a rougher texture. I use this daily just before I use the Super Hard weave; DO NOT recommend for those with sensitive/thin skin. Tip to save water: use a bucket; fill while letting the body and cloth get thoroughly wet; apply face wash and allow to sit on the skin; apply body wash to cloth; the bucket having been filled, TURN OFF WATER, give yourself a good scrub down; rinse with bucket water and finally one more time with shower. First I saw this towel in my mom's house and ordered it for myself.  This is exactly I was looking for!  It helps to clean and massage the skin; very convenient to rub the back and any part of your body, and leave you with the nice feeling of freshness and rejuvenated.  The towel is easy washable and almost instantaneously dries out.  Delivery was fast, price is reasonable. Definitely recommend to everybody.

reviews.t: If you like "scratchy" washcloths, just buy this. It's better, cleaner and just amazing.
reviews.x: I got 2 of these, 110 and 120 "grit" (for lack of a better word, and because these remind me of sandpaper).  The 120 is my favorite. It's better than any exfoliating brush, cloth or soap I have ever tried in my whole life. They were both VERY long, but I cut them in half and there was minimal unraveling (honestly, about 5 strings from the cut edges and it stopped. It's hard to even tell where they were cut now!). AND they rinse absolutely clean very easily. No having to squish them out m

These are great body polishing cloths.  This green is stronger harder feel than the blue but are not a scratchy feeling as the Salux.  Having said that, once I used them the feeling was great and after a shower my skin felt very stimulated.  The extra long length, 20cm over Salux, makes it much easier to wrap around areas and scrub.  Depending on your preference on length, you could actually cut in half and make two cloths.  You might consider treating the cut ends with a flame to melt in order

I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin and I hesitated to try this but my Bath and Bodyworks shower "puff" wasn't exfoliating at all.  I truthfully didn't realize they came in "strengths", I just loved the color for my green bathroom! Thankfully, even with my very sensitive skin the HARD WEAVE wasn't too harsh! It's just perfect for me!  I am so glad I bought these because they really exfoliate without tearing or irritating my skin and my skin is SO SOFT AND SMOOTH after my showers!

Better than scrunchy. It's rough enough to exfoliate the skin and I can wash my back. It foams up fast just like a scrunchy and it's easy to dry out. I just fold it back and forth in small rectangles. Then shake it out in the show when done and it's dry.
Love these! Can't take a shower without one! I have several that I keep on hand for when we travel or need to replace them. I grew up using them and I don't feel clean unless I use this.

reviews.t: They are large enough for me to give my back a good scrub, along with the rest of me
reviews.x: I use these to replace washcloths, and have done for years.  They are large enough for me to give my back a good scrub, along with the rest of me! I must say I have the softest skin of anyone I know, and recommend these to all my friends.  Buy them! They are fabulous, and you won't need to purchase those useless overpriced scrubs.

This thing is truly amazing!!!  I wanted to try this before I bought something that is $50.  I'm glad I did!  My skin is soft and glowing.  I used it gently on my face and it definitely made a difference there as well.  I received this in 1 day!!!  Will buy from again. Thank you!

reviews.t: As advertised and great for travel
reviews.x: Exfoliates well, dries fast, and easy to transport. I use it for travel and at the gym. Easy to hang dry overnight and use again. Launders well without issue.

reviews.x: Great for exfoliating skin and these are long enough to wash my back by myself. This is all I use. I use it on my face and neck as well. They last forever!

reviews.t: Works great ... just too big ... gives you too much for your money.
reviews.x: The only complaint I have with this product is that I had to get out the sewing machine, and using nylon thread, reduce its size. Other than that it fine.
I highly recommend this product...It is an excellent exfolliating cloth that lasts a very long time....drys quickly and rinses even quicker.

reviews.x: The perfect length so you can scrub your back and I love how rough it is. It makes my skin feel soft after a shower.
The best quality! I've been searching for that product 15 years!!! Highly recommend!!!
Accept no imitation, scrubbies or whatnot. This is the classic exfoliating towel.
Good deal for product for the price.  Arrived on schedule.

reviews.t: Lasts a long time; perfect texture
reviews.x: I just bought my second one of these. The first one lasted two years, but it was getting very worn out. It actually got a little rougher the older it got. This new one reminded me how soft yet still exfoliating the cloth was when brand new.  I think this cloth is the perfect texture--no other shower cloth I've had has come close. The thing I like about it the most is that it does not slip against itself when all soapy and get unfolded, like others I've had. The weave helps it to grip against its

I have  purchased several of these for myself and for gifts. My sister sent me one for Christmas and now I am hooked. They really do a great job of making your skin so much smoother. One of the best things about this towel is that you can do your backside,  as the towel is long enough to easily accomplish that. Would give this product more stars if I could.

For me, just right...not too hard, not too soft! I hate when any kind of exfoliating / exfoliant is too soft. And I was almost feeling like this might be just maybe, kinda, a little, too soft bc it is very comfortable, but I was wrong.  This towel leaves the skin super, super smooth and exfoliated. So definitely does the trick even while feeling good!

I definitely love this exfoliater. It is just as discribed, quite a nice size and has a neon green color. The cloth is rough enough that it will exfoliate but doesn't feel like sandpaper when you add soap. It is a little bit big for traveling but you can fold it and store it very nicely. I would 100% recommend this exfoliating cloth!

Shorter and less rough on your skin than the blue 120cm version.  Still course enough to feel rough.  The blue is very course and more rough overall.  If you want to feel the towel but don't want to feel as though it's scraping your skin off, go with this one over the blue.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the towel for effective exfoliation, leaving skin soft, smooth, and glowing.
Many reviewers highlight the long length, which makes it easy to scrub their own back and body.
Several reviewers note the towel dries quickly, is easy to launder, and is convenient for travel or the gym.
Some reviewers describe the hard weave as rough or scratchy, though opinions vary on whether it is too harsh.
A few reviewers mention the towel is very long or large, with one cutting or sewing it to reduce its size.
